anchors.finding: Finite retained interface, integer event order and scope; tesseract boundary is in Q4 edges times ternary role fibre.
For k unconstrained retained ternary positions, C3=log_3(3^k)=k; not a mass conversion.
Certified retained-start return adds one closure; atomic phase-bearing support m excludes dwell/replay and has m>=2.
Distinct certified reclosures supply beats; Sep_j=k_{j+1}-k_j; cadence is exact ordered separation list; arbitrary native windows have an origin indicator.
Wave identity retains origin and cadence; localized wavelet binds adjacent certified return events and positive local separation.
RD=first branch+hinge recurrence+return branch; symmetric single hinge gives 2Pi+1 only with its hypotheses.
Pi(p:q)=q^p+q is a declared finite support model; proposed grammar requires actual admission trace.
Outer scope must bind actual inner identities and actual outer return. Each certified outer closure contributes one; inner beats cannot be recounted as outer returns.
Directional RCD binds both histories/reflection; additive realization RD+sum r_s; compatible native window clip preserves RCD and RD.
Coupled recurrent histories on common committed window give exact beat ratio, unwrapped lag and relational time; no global scalar clock.
Coarsest admitted resolution with declared tie order; Nsupport from actual section/support family; Nmax=min(candidate,support,capacity bound,window/duration bound).
Retained address range, tesseract section grade and support-expression family separately determine finite support multiplicity.
RD-as-period is only an explicitly periodic display specialization.
Geometry weighted support sum with separate cell identities/multiplicities; no cross-dimensional measure conversion without weights and geometry.
Measured-track ingest specifies grid, timing, quantization and mass/size-to-beta map.
Candidate beta_a from mass/size is positive integer; Q mod beta_a produces phase counts.
Released fixed coordinate fixture sets BETA_A=5 and LAG=1; no measured mass/size mapping function in that script.
Native return histories to cycle equivalents to SI time; gains/calibration separately bound.
Own source or inferred/proxy rows may populate 3D density/velocity/current/time-flow; each status recorded.

derived_from_trace.full_common_record_window: intersection of committed observation domains for a coupled comparison; all pending support and boundary crossings retained; stop at recorded end, not hypothetical next beat
derived_from_trace.RCD: directional bound histories, reflection, duration projection; additive specialization only when bound
derived_from_trace.native_capacity: k retained unconstrained ternary positions -> C3=k
derived_from_trace.native_range: actual retained address/section family and admitted fold depth

data_inference_allowed.mass_per_cell: rho_c * physical cell volume, with density/geometry uncertainty; not equal to C3
data_inference_allowed.three_dimensional_density: fit positive density distributions through their actual 2D projection to photometry/gas constraints; preserve degenerate fits and extrapolated tails
data_inference_allowed.native_embedding: bind reconstruction cell identities, native supports and calibrated unit/observation map explicitly; never infer an atomic closure certificate from density alone
data_inference_allowed.temporal_data: reconstruct kinematic/time inputs from independent field data where available, then compute native closures/cadence from engine histories; a static projection alone does not observe native event order
data_inference_allowed.fit_status: if Vobs participates in fitting, resulting Vobs residual is an in-sample reconstruction score, not held-out prediction
